Chat end-to-end on PR branch: resident session create via the single session-params funnel ([bb] name + thread cwd), attach snapshot boundary, streamed turns (text/thinking/tool deltas, usage, boundaries), soft stop preserving the session file, live E2E green against 0.7.3 and 0.9.1 daemons, recorded lane committed and replaying green through dist/host.js.

Extension picker on PR branch: provider settings page lists discovered user prime extensions (mirrors prime's own resolution: extensions dir + settings.json entries) with default-off toggles plus an escape-hatch path list; enabled paths ride create.config.extensions through the session-params seam next to the dynamic-tools fragment, noExtensions stays true; new-sessions-only verified by test. Suite 158 passed; live check loaded an enabled fixture extension while discovery stayed off.

Persistence on PR branch: reopen/resume rebuilds the timeline once from the attach snapshot (adopted sessions via daemon-derived providerThreadId); discard = soft-stop then kill + delete_saved_session, one-way and retryable on failure, addressing only the thread's own session; release keeps the file; closing bb never kills (onClose releases only). Live lane covers release -> out-of-band work -> reopen -> discard. Finding recorded: the daemon journals mutations by (clientId, envelope id) and replays recorded responses — live test clients mint fresh clientIds; the bridge sends no fixed ids and is unaffected.

Steering on PR branch: turn/steer maps to daemon steer (steering lane; delivered after in-flight work — in 0.7.3 effectively at run end with the answer as a new run, recorded honestly in the translator), idle steer rides resumeIfIdle; turn/start on a busy session queues as prompt streamingBehavior:followUp (delivered only after the agent finishes); queue state surfaces as extension.state prime-agent/queue from session_action_update + an attach-time get_queue read. Live steer verified twice against 0.7.3.

Models/thinking/compaction on PR branch: model/list answered from prime's own catalog via a throwaway client_owned catalog lane (no curated list, capability-gated, 5-min per-cwd cache); model id splits into prime provider+model; set_model/set_thinking_level applied before the prompt with honest refusal of unsupported levels (prime would silently clamp into global settings); manual /compact mapped onto compact with compaction events on the timeline and skipped-compaction as provider.warning. bb-side gaps documented: no grammar row for model/thinking/compaction state (mirrored via provider/raw prime.session_state), no surface for set_auto_compaction (stays prime-side). Live: catalog + thinking_level_changed + /compact verified.

Skills on PR branch: native skill roots (user ~/.prime/agent/skills + project .prime/agent/skills with ancestor walk, mirrored after prime's own loading rules) feed the /-menu via experimental_nativeSkillRoots + the host resolver contract; skills/configure root paths ride create.config.skills (additive over prime's own discovery, noSkills stays false); bb slash mentions rewrite to prime's /skill:<name> command form with drift guards; /compact stays bb's builtin handled by bbpa-ggf.6's compaction path. Live: a project skill listed via get_commands and executed from a slash mention. noExtensions:true pinned by tests.

Subagents read-only on PR branch: rlm_child_update -> delegation items keyed by child id (open once/progress/settle once, attach currentOrLast so background children survive the boundary); snapshot.children rebuild the roster on adopted resume; new bb.app frontend registers the Subagents panel fed by a per-machine read-only daemon client (slim attach once per session, live rlm_child_update pushes, TTL sweep, worker-retention lease), host RPC subagents.roster + realtime signals; send_message/cancel_rlm_child untouched for bbpa-ggf.10. Live check: read-only attach + empty roster on a childless session; a live subagent spawn is first exercised by bbpa-ggf.14's smoke.

Resilience on PR branch: the connection layer now runs a real bounded recovery loop (connection events lost/restored/unavailable, capped backoff, parked unsent commands, dead-transport drop so the next command dials afresh); lanes settle an interrupted turn themselves on drop (failureDeltas), re-attach on a fresh snapshot on restore without duplicating or losing turns, park turns submitted during the restart until re-attached, and skip abort/detach while the wire is down; drift surfaces as deduped provider.warning (verified provider/recovery restartRecommended+threadId would restart the bridge process, so it was deliberately avoided); stale other-generation daemons get a warning and verified no takeover (no restart/shutdown/prepare_update_restart/reload/kill/delete_saved_session in the scenario). Dynamic tools re-publish on reconnect without code changes (asserted).

Subagent control on PR branch: host contract gains subagents.steer (send_message targeted at the child's own activeSessionId, else childId for unbooted; fromActiveSessionId=parent; delivery honest: delivered/queued/unknown) and subagents.stop (cancel_rlm_child, {cancelled:true} literal - a false throws so a panel-visible stop happened); wake-guard refuses steering non-live children (prime would wake them); no-ledger-deletion pinned by tests over every recorded command; panel adds per-row steer+stop while live with pending-only optimism, refusals rendered next to the row, authoritative state from the roster. Live check: both commands admitted by the real daemon, cancel of a nonexistent child answers {cancelled:false}, cleanup verified; the steer-into-real-child round trip is bbpa-ggf.14's.

Fork and rename on PR branch: prime's fork is a replace-in-place transcript branch, so the bridge brackets it (get_state -> tree/fork points -> fork at the entry -> get_state branch file -> switch_session back -> verified restore -> create {sessionPath: branch}); settled prompt turns mint bbpa-ck-<ordinal>-<digest> checkpoints with zero extra traffic, resolved against prime's fork-point discovery and extended to the anchored turn's end; bb copies the inherited timeline itself so the snapshot arms the boundary without replaying content. Rename rides primeSessionName (prefix + thread id kept) via rename/rename_saved_session. Live: fork from a checkpoint with both sessions listed under [bb] names, rename lands in the catalog, forked thread streams.

Live smoke on PR branch: npm run smoke (scripts/live-smoke.ts) - four named layers with per-layer failure attribution, real run green on the merged branch in ~48s: hello+schema, [bb] session with streamed turn + mid-turn steer, subagent spawn -> roster live -> child steered via the panel path -> child stopped (cancelled:true, delegation item interrupted, parent unaffected) -> full cleanup verified against list + list_saved_sessions.
